note: Written on 2026-11-25 before the keyword reader or the Gemini Nano prompt existed, and not changed after any run. Each is what a person might type about their own situation, with made-up names. 'codes' are the ways in the words clearly say are there now; 'living' and 'children_shared' are filled only when the words say so. Something the person says is over, or only a worry, is not a code.
